validation_query: SELECT id, store_id, product_id, move_type, predicted_recaptured_usd, priority, status FROM northpeak.replenishment_actions ORDER BY priority, predicted_recaptured_usd DESC;
query_purpose: Verify the priority column exists in northpeak.replenishment_actions after migration 001, and that backfill assigned correct integer values (1=high urgency, 5=low) based on predicted_recaptured_usd thresholds.
validation_notes: All 5 rows show priority column populated. Backfill rule applied correctly: predicted >= 2000 -> priority 1 (ids 1,4); predicted >= 1000 -> priority 2 (id 2); predicted >= 500 -> priority 3 (ids 3,5). CHECK constraint (priority BETWEEN 1 AND 5) is active. Index idx_replenishment_priority confirmed by \d output.
